title: StandingPolicyFloor
description: Source of truth: trust-compute gradient brainstorm §2.8 (standing-immune floor) plus light-up-the-graph spec (vouch primitive). Validates the full standing-policy manifest payload: the five standing-immune floor classes (which cannot be eroded by the standing gradient), the debitWeights map (per-signalKind standing impact, including the vouch positive-polarity weights for accept-correction and restitution), the unknownTreatment policy (how the receiving node treats unknown-author EPRs), and the per-reach standing thresholds. Mishpat-DNA-notarized; collectives may be more protective, never less. T7 (Manifest validator extension) bundles this schema via include_str! and validates it at integrity-zome create-time when manifestKind == standing-policy.

manifestKind.description: Discriminator. Must equal 'standing-policy' for this schema to apply.

revision.description: Monotonic revision number. Higher revision wins on idempotent replay.

classes.description: Exactly the five standing-immune floor classes. All five must be declared; order is not significant. Collectives may extend protection but not reduce below these declared floors.

class.description: Standing-immune floor class identifier. local-relationship-reach: unconditional family/household propagation never standing-gated. cid-targeted-lookup: anyone with a CID can fetch; standing modulates discovery, not retrievability. constitutional-floor-signatures: mishpat decisions and imagodei-as-counsel signatures are always per-message verified regardless of author standing. new-voice-baseline: first-time author has nonzero floor derived from sponsor; never starts at zero. vulnerable-class-elevation: children, refugees, persecution-targets, and displaced persons receive elevated baseline floor.

protection.description: Human-readable description of what this class protects. Bootstrap manifests (T17) fill this content; this schema enforces the shape.

appliesWhen.description: Optional context condition under which this protection activates. Omit for unconditional protections.

debitWeights.description: Map of feedback-signal kind to (impact -> standing delta) weights. Negative deltas (vouch, retraction) are recoveries; positive deltas (squelch, correction, quarantine) are debits. Resolved via ManifestDebitWeightPolicy at standing application time.

score.description: Baseline standing tier for a first-time author (e.g. 'floor', 'low').

vulnerableClassLift.description: Optional lift applied to vulnerable-class authors above the new-voice baseline.

newVoiceBaseline.description: Optional new-voice baseline policy. Governs the floor a first-time author starts at and the lift applied to vulnerable-class attestations.

default.description: How the receiving node treats EPRs from unknown authors absent any standing evidence. conservative: floor-only, low-reach. newVoiceBaseline: apply newVoiceBaseline policy. neutral: middle-of-gradient until evidence arrives.

evidenceSources.description: Optional list of evidence-source identifiers (e.g. sponsor attestation kinds) the projector consults before applying the default treatment.

unknownTreatment.description: Policy for handling unknown-author EPRs at projector time.

reachThresholds.description: Per-reach standing threshold required for an EPR to be eligible for projection at that reach. Reach::is_floor_allowed (T11) consults this to honor floor classes (e.g. local-relationship-reach is 'any' regardless of standing).
